editorial.verdict: The CS7000X is the budget computerized package: 70 stitches, 7 one-step buttonholes, 10 feet, a wide table and a hard case for under $300, with a 750 spm ceiling and an unpublished throat that cap its quilting ambitions.
editorial.whoFor: A first machine buyer who wants computerized stitch selection, needle up/down and a wide table for piecing and lap quilts at the lowest price.
editorial.skipIf: You need speed above 750 spm, a published throat wider than a standard domestic, or a heavier machine for regular canvas and denim work.
editorial.keySpec: 70 stitches · 750 spm · 7 mm width · 10 feet and wide table · 10.5 lb

faqs.q: Is the Brother CS7000X good for quilting?
faqs.a: It has a drop feed for free motion, a detachable wide table and quilting stitches. Its throat is not published in inches and top speed is 750 spm, so it suits lap quilts more than bed quilts.

faqs.q: What is the throat space on the CS7000X?
faqs.a: Not published. Brother describes a large needle-to-arm workspace without a measurement.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the CS7000X and the CS7000i?
faqs.a: The X is the current model; both list 70 stitches. Published differences were not captured in search results, so check the label when buying used.

faqs.q: How fast does the CS7000X sew?
faqs.a: Up to 750 stitches per minute per dealer listings.
One review site reports sewing multiple layers of denim. We have not tested it; the machine is a 10.5 lb domestic and Brother makes no thick-fabric claim on the page found.

faqs.q: What feet come with the CS7000X?
faqs.a: Ten presser feet plus a wide table and hard case, per dealer listings. The exact foot list was not captured.

faqs.q: Does the CS7000X have a metal frame?
faqs.a: Walmart listing titles say Durable Metal Frame. Brother's own page wording was not captured, so it is recorded as a listing claim.

faqs.q: What is the warranty on the CS7000X?
faqs.a: 25 years on the chassis casting, 2 years on electronic components and circuit boards, 1 year on parts, labor and accessories, per the Sewing Machines Plus listing.

faqs.q: How much does the Brother CS7000X cost?
faqs.a: About $280 new; $279.99 was the Amazon third-party price tracked on 2026-09-18, and Best Buy quotes $302.49 comparable value.
